senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. נקש)to clap, catch in a trap.

units: <cite ref="Midrash Mishlei 6:1">Midr. Prov. to VI, 2</cite> [read:] <he>נוֹקַשְׁתֶּם באמרי פיכם וכ׳</he> you have been entrapped through your own words (<cite ref="Exodus 24:7">Ex. XXIV, 7</cite>), you have been caught (taken captives) through (neglecting) them.
